_comment: Self-documenting settings manifest (NOT a Duda-imposed format). Each entry is one config field read off data.config.* — the search-specific toggles via form-state readSearchConfig(), the shared geo/collection fields via core/config readConfig(). Duda serialises every value as a string; the readers coerce. Legacy config keys are preserved so existing sites keep working.

fields.label: Show Keyword search
fields.help: Free-text keyword input. Publishes as `keyword` in the filter payload.

fields.label: Show Job Type dropdown
fields.help: Top level of the classification tree (jobTypeID).

fields.label: Show Sub-Classification dropdown
fields.help: Leaf level (roleID). Options depend on the selected classification.

fields.label: Show proximity search
fields.help: Location text input with geocode.maps.co suggestions + a radius slider. Requires geocodeApiKey; publishes `geo` + `geoRange`.

fields.label: geocode.maps.co API key
fields.help: Enables the proximity location suggestions + radius search. Empty = proximity field stays hidden.

fields.label: Radius unit
fields.help: Radius slider unit for proximity search (shared with the results widget).

fields.label: Job collection
fields.help: Name/id of the Duda job collection the dropdowns are populated from.
